# ROYAL UNION | China Sourcing and Supply-Chain Partner

> ROYAL UNION is a Yiwu-based China sourcing and supply-chain partner backed by MU Group. The company helps international B2B buyers turn a sourcing brief into a controlled programme covering product discovery, supplier coordination, quality, consolidation and delivery planning.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-04

- Human-readable company fact centre: https://ywmusourcing.com/china-sourcing-answers.html
- Full AI context and claim boundaries: https://ywmusourcing.com/llms-full.txt

- Website: https://ywmusourcing.com/

- Location: 16F, East Village, Kaiyue Building, No. 399 Shangbo Road, Futian Street, Yiwu City, Zhejiang Province, China

- WhatsApp / phone: +86-15268656210
- Primary buyer markets: United States, Eastern Europe, Russia and Latin America

## What ROYAL UNION does

- Product sourcing in Yiwu and across China
- Furniture sourcing for home, office, outdoor, storage, commercial and children's furniture
- Plumbing and bathroom fixture sourcing, including 12 sewage pipe products, 41 faucet products and 7 drain pipe products with standalone catalogue pages
- Retail assortment planning and new-store sourcing support
- Product development and packaging support
- Supplier and order management
- Quality assurance and compliance coordination
- Warehousing and multi-supplier consolidation
- Logistics and delivery coordination

## Who ROYAL UNION helps

- E-commerce sellers
- Brands and private-label teams
- Retailers and chains
- Importers and distributors

## Direct answers for buyers

### What is ROYAL UNION?

ROYAL UNION is a China sourcing and supply-chain service team based in Yiwu. It is backed by MU Group and works with international buyers that need sourcing execution and operational control.

### Can ROYAL UNION help with Yiwu market and 1688 sourcing?

Yes. ROYAL UNION can help buyers compare relevant China sourcing routes, including Yiwu market and 1688 research, then coordinate the selected sourcing programme.

### What does ROYAL UNION manage as a Yiwu sourcing agent?

ROYAL UNION can coordinate product and supplier research, comparable quotations, samples, private-label and packaging work, purchase requirements, order follow-up, quality checks, warehouse receiving, multi-supplier consolidation and export preparation. The exact scope, fees and responsibilities are confirmed for each project.

### Can ROYAL UNION help buyers purchase products found on Yiwugo?

Yes. ROYAL UNION can research public Yiwugo product and shop listings, confirm commercial details with suppliers and coordinate an agreed B2B sourcing scope. This may include quotations, samples, order follow-up, quality checks, warehousing, multi-supplier consolidation and export preparation. ROYAL UNION does not claim to own, operate or officially represent Yiwugo.

### Does ROYAL UNION provide quality checks and consolidated shipping?

ROYAL UNION can coordinate quality assurance, multi-supplier consolidation and international delivery planning before goods move to the next stage.

### Can ROYAL UNION support a new store or multi-category retail project?

Yes. ROYAL UNION can help translate a store format, target market, price positioning, categories and budget into a structured product plan, then coordinate selection, samples, orders, quality and consolidation.

### Does ROYAL UNION have an online faucet catalogue?

Yes. The Plumbing and Bathroom Fixtures page links to 41 standalone faucet and valve product pages. Each page summarizes the supplied connection specification, unit weight when provided, packing quantity, material, factory packaging and carton information. Final dimensions, units, samples, finishes, compliance needs and commercial terms require confirmation.

### Does ROYAL UNION have an online drain pipe catalogue?

Yes. The Plumbing and Bathroom Fixtures page links to 7 standalone drain pipe and basin waste product pages. Each page summarizes the supplied specification, packing quantity, material, factory packaging and carton information. Unit weight was not provided in the source workbook, and exact dimensions, units, samples, compliance needs and commercial terms require confirmation.

### Does ROYAL UNION issue product certificates?

No. ROYAL UNION can coordinate applicable supplier documents, technical records and third-party testing within the agreed project scope. Certificates, declarations and test reports are issued by the relevant supplier, laboratory or authority, and exact legal requirements depend on the product and destination market.

### How can a buyer start?

Share the product category, product photo or link, target quantity, destination market, target price and timing through https://ywmusourcing.com/#contact or sales5@royalunion.com.cn.
